title: Triage first prefil bringup run of Mistral Medium 3.5
body:
Triage list for the first prefill bring-up run of Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B on a 4x8 Blackhole Galaxy mesh.

Source: `models/demos/mistral_3_5_d_p/bringup_log.jsonl` (recipe `6e82a44`). Every `judgment` event from that run is listed below in log order — 16 total. These are the calls made during bring-up that were *not* dictated by the spec or the donor model, so each one deserves a second pair of eyes.

**Committee column is intentionally empty** — please fill in who investigates each row.

Kind breakdown: 5 `recipe_gap`, 5 `donor_wrong`, 2 `spec_gap`, 2 `env`, 2 `ttnn_gap`, 1 `model_quirk`.

| Stage | Kind | Issue | Fix | Committee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | spec_gap | `max_seq_len` 262144 is 51.2 chunks of 5120, but the whole-cache block-cyclic rope and KV table tile by chunk | Added `spec.cache_capacity = ceil(max_seq_len/chunk_size)*chunk_size = 266240`; `max_seq_len` stays the servable context | |
| D1 | donor_wrong | Donor rope `_delta` said Mistral takes HF yarn float correction dims, but HF defaults `truncate=True` when the key is absent | Verified against `_compute_yarn_parameters`: use floor/ceil (`truncate=True`) for Mistral; exposed as a rope arg | |
| D2 | env | `FABRIC_1D_RING` + the torus descriptor cannot map on this pod: it is a plain 8x4 grid with no wrap-around links | Default to `FABRIC_1D` + `single_bh_galaxy_mesh` descriptor with `ttnn.Topology.Linear`; `MISTRAL_LINEAR_FABRIC=0` selects the torus | |
| D2 | env | The system mesh presents as 8x4 but the spec targets mesh (4,8) with tp on the cols | `ttnn.open_mesh_device(MeshShape(4,8))` reshapes the 8x4 system mesh view; verified both shapes open | |
| D3 | ttnn_gap | `ttnn.rms_norm` throws at hidden 12288: its interleaved kernel CBs grow to 2565120 B, over the 1572864 B L1 budget | Composed the norm from multiply/mean/rsqrt with an fp32 sum of squares; width-independent, PCC 0.99999 | |
| D3 | donor_wrong | Donor projections call `ttnn.linear` with default compute config; at hidden 12288 / inter 28672, bf16 dest accumulation caps a layer at 0.989 | Added `get_matmul_compute_config` (HiFi4, `fp32_dest_acc_en=True`) for QKV/o_proj/MLP; layer PCC 0.989 -> 0.996 | |
| D3 | donor_wrong | Donor casts the SDPA output to bf8 before o_proj; measured worth 2e-5 PCC and it obscures the accumulation problem | Dropped the cast from `apply_output_projection` and recorded the measured cost in its docstring | |
| M1 | spec_gap | The published 128B checkpoint is unreachable from this host, so the M1 ground-truth row had nothing real to load | Wrote `make_synthetic_checkpoint.py` emitting the checkpoint's exact on-disk format (fp8 + scales + wrapper prefix) as the loader oracle | |
| M3 | recipe_gap | The spec pcc 0.99 is unreachable on the residual stream at depth: a bf16 CPU forward of the same weights scores 0.92-0.99 there | Gate per-layer KV at 0.99 (passes at 0.997) and gate the residual stream on tracking a bf16 reference within 0.01 | |
| P1 | ttnn_gap | The 2D vocab-parallel embedding returns wrong rows above 4096 tokens per chunk, silently: layer 0 KV PCC 0.995 with nothing raised | Defaulted to the 1D hidden-only sharding (exact at 5120) and added a test pinning the 2D defect at its 4096-token boundary | |
| P1 | donor_wrong | Donor `ProgramConfig` sets `fp32_dest_acc_en=False` for every SDPA, but that constraint only applies to the ring cache-read op | Defaulted the plain-SDPA compute config to fp32 accumulation; one-shot L3 KV PCC 0.957 -> 0.978 | |
| P3 | recipe_gap | The engine reads `runtime.config.use_trace` and passes `prefill_chunk(metadata_msg=)`, neither of which the `gpt_oss_d_p` donor runtime has | Added the `use_trace` field (False) and an ignored `metadata_msg` kwarg; both kill the runner at startup otherwise | |
| P3 | donor_wrong | The shared producer read-back branch was named for gpt-oss but its logic is generic dense GQA | Renamed it `_read_slot_kv_and_check_pcc_dense_gqa` and dispatched both model names to it, dims from `ADAPTER.model_config` | |
| P4 | model_quirk | The table keys on GLOBAL token position but addresses RAW cache rows, and the block-cyclic layout is not the identity past one chunk | Invert `blockcyclic_positions` to map global position to shard row before comparing; a bank block is 32 consecutive shard rows | |
| P3 | recipe_gap | The shared e2e test forces `PREFILL_ENABLE_LAYER_ACK=1` and `PREFILL_LAYER_ACK_D2H=1`, which both donor runtimes reject outright | Implemented the D2H ack: one `outbound_socket_service_sync` per layer, mutually exclusive with the host channel; 22/22 acks drained | |
| P3 | recipe_gap | `prefill_producer` resolves its adapter from `PREFILL_MODEL` only and never reads `PREFILL_MANIFEST`, so it silently ran as the default MLA model | Export `PREFILL_MODEL` and `PREFILL_SP/TP` alongside `PREFILL_MANIFEST`; noted in the manifest itself | |
